correctness.rationale: For a general pencil the smooth zero locus has the expected codimension six, so its ambient class is c_6((∧²S∨)⊕²)=∏_{i<j}(x_i+x_j)². Grassmannian integration against the Vandermonde gives the stated multinomial/falling-factorial formula; a separate exact expansion confirmed the polynomial identity, and independent localization agreed for n=3,4,5,6 (including 61 versus 5 and 10329 versus 462). The hook-length formula for the comparison Grassmannian gives the stated ratio; its excess over one is 3(n−2)(6n−11)(7n−5)/(n(n−1)(2n−1)), strictly positive on the claimed domain. The cited normal form pairs indices summing to ±1, so the four odd indices −3,−1,1,3 span a common isotropic four-space and give a Plücker line by fixing a two-plane. Thus the Plücker classes are generators in the rank-one integral H² groups. The absolute coefficient of their top power in the top integral group is a graded-ring invariant, regardless of preservation of polarization or orientation.
residual_risks: The localization replay is a finite cross-check; all-parameter correctness uses the exact polynomial identity and general geometry, not extrapolation from the degrees.

value.rationale: The odd biisotropic series and its additive twins come from a specific geometric comparison theorem, whose authors distinguish the product question. A computable primitive top-power invariant uniformly separates the abstract integral rings and supplies exact intersection numbers even without a full ring presentation. The value is in the uniform comparison beyond the already known lowest case, not in recomputing that case.
residual_risks: No ring presentation for the rest of the series or result for other ranks follows from this obstruction alone.
